ranking.reason: Off-by-one guard: `used > 1` skips coupon transition for used==1, so exactly one coupon can only be spent at the start; should be `used > 0`.
Initializing all start states used>=1 to 0 lets surplus coupons be consumed at the start, masking/reinforcing the off-by-one in coupon usage.
Coupon transition reads used-1; correct only when guard admits used==1, so it silently never fires for the single-coupon state.
